Use AGENTS.md and AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md as repository-level conventions (Lite or Full mode). Before edits read .ai/HANDOFF.md and relevant task state; check for stale state. Keep diffs narrow, verify results, update handoff (stamp date+agent, merge don't overwrite). Skills require trusted-source verification and explicit user approval for install or execution. For run-based work use scripts/uw_context_guard.py brief/check/prompt; task partitioning does not split the context window.
